# Input Excitation

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

<a name="calibration-guide-link"></a>

**Before interpreting the results:** [What was calibrated: experimental EMG, fitted excitation, mechanical parameters and the forward calculation](../../Documentation/calibration_summary.md).

The authoritative fixed motor waveform is excitation_cycle.tsv. Its first column is normalized input phase, not seconds; multiply by the period for time. Activation is a computed state.

- [excitation_cycle.tsv](excitation_cycle.tsv) — One prescribed cycle: phase plus 104 dimensionless excitation columns.
- [muscle_input_dictionary.csv](muscle_input_dictionary.csv) — Channel identifiers, limb, anatomy, function and source/measurement status.
